(TKO) forward takeoff: a video of the diving sub-action forward takeoff, a takeoff phase
The diver stands firmly on the springboard with arms extended forward, preparing for the takeoff.
The diver begins to swing their arms back, initiating the momentum for the forward takeoff.
The diver's body starts to rise off the springboard as they continue to swing their arms backward.
